reason: Primary purpose is to provide an installable DSH wrapper that registers the Riffkit skill for DeepSeek Harness agents, enabling access to its short-form video remixing function. Evidence shows it is a thin packaging layer (DSH bundle + cordis patch + skill root), with keywords and metadata emphasizing AI short-video/TikTok-related use, rather than standalone tooling logic. Risk is moderate because it depends on an external service workflow and remote-sourced updates.

summaries.zh: 该插件将 Riffkit 的短视频改编技能打包为可安装的 DSH 插件，让 DeepSeek Harness 代理可在技能体系中加载并使用该创作能力。
summaries.en: This plugin packages the Riffkit skill as an installable DSH bundle so DeepSeek Harness agents can load it from their skills stack and use short-form video remixing capabilities.

capabilities: Adds a DSH plugin bundle that registers a dedicated skills root for the Riffkit skill.
Enables agents to invoke Riffkit short-video remix capabilities through the registered skill interface.
Supports periodic re-synchronization/version heartbeat behavior tied to remote skill metadata sources.
